title: Stefano Carrara
summary:
Stefano Carrara is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers soundtrack, including the songs Huntik Go and Heroes and Titans which were released commercially in 2010.

He has worked alongside Fabrizio Castania and Michele Bettali on many different projects, including Huntiks sister show, Winx Club.

raw_wikitext:
'''Stefano Carrara''' is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'' soundtrack, including the songs ''[[Huntik Go]]'' and ''[[Heroes and Titans]]'' which were released commercially in 2010.

He has worked alongside [[Fabrizio Castania]] and [[Michele Bettali]] on many different projects, including ''Huntik'''s sister show, ''Winx Club''.
